The '''Rokaria system''' was located in the [[Tynquay sector/Legends|Tynquay sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TransHydian" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to<ref name="Planetnamia" /> [[Rokarian dirt-fish/Legends|Rokarian dirt-fish]].<ref name="CloakOfDarkness" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rokaria [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]]. The book placed it in grid square L-8 as part of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]],<ref name="TEA" /> with its [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] further placing it in the [[Ehosiq sector/Legends|Ehosiq sector]];<ref name="EAOC" /> however, that was an erroneous draft placement<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31618822|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2011-03-26|time=10:56 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220126185656/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-163#post-31618822|quote=Rokaria was already mapped in Tynquay; the appendix listing in the ER was a draft placement that should have been updated.}}</ref> that was eventually corrected in a later edition of the Online Companion.<ref name="EAOC" />
